dispute_ticket.description: I was charged $39.60 for a trip quoted at $27, plus a $30 cleaning fee the next morning. The surge was never shown to me, the driver took the ECP even though I told him to use the PIE, and I did not dirty his car. I want the surge, the extra fare and the cleaning fee all refunded. After the trip he also threatened me.

app_events.details: Upfront fare S$27.00 shown to rider: S$18.00 x 1.5 surge. Surge banner displayed: 'Fares are higher due to high demand'.
Rider R-6620 booked RydeX trip RYDE-STRESS-003, ION Orchard to Our Tampines Hub, upfront fare S$27.00. Planned route via PIE, 18.0 km.
Driver D-5207 (Tan Wei Ming, Toyota Corolla Altis SMB 2207 H) assigned.
Traffic feed: PIE eastbound moderate congestion near Kallang. No closure.
Rider added stop in app: Paya Lebar Quarter. Planned route updated to 20.0 km.
Upfront fare updated to S$30.00 for the added stop (S$20.00 x 1.5 surge). Shown to rider.
Vehicle left the recommended route (PIE) onto ECP.
Trip completed. Distance 25.2 km (plan after added stop 20.0 km, +26%).
Route change 26% above plan exceeds 20%: upfront fare replaced by metered fare. Final fare S$39.60 (metered S$26.40 x 1.5 surge) charged to credit card.
Driver submitted cleaning claim S$30.00 with 1 photo of a wet rear floor mat. Photo taken 2026-10-10 01:18 (2 h 47 min after trip end).
S$30.00 cleaning fee charged to rider credit card.

platform_policy.fare_basis: upfront fare set at booking; updated when the rider adds a stop in the app
platform_policy.route_change_measured_against: the planned route after any stop the rider added in the app
detour_billable_only_if: the rider agreed to it in chat or in the app
platform_policy.unbillable_detour_triggering_metered_fal: the rider pays the last upfront fare shown to them; the difference is refunded

expected_outcome.reason: Three asks. (1) Surge: the quote showed 1.5x with a surge banner and the rider tapped 'Accept higher fare' before booking, so the surge stands. (2) Extra fare: the rider refused the ECP in chat and there was no closure (moderate congestion only), so the detour was not billable; it pushed the route 26% over the plan and triggered the metered fare. The rider pays the last upfront fare shown, S$30.00 after the stop they added (not the original S$27.00): refund S$39.60 - S$30.00 = S$9.60. (3) Cleaning fee: the only photo was taken 2 h 47 min after the trip, beyond the 60-minute rule, so the S$30.00 fee is reversed even though the rider admitted a small spill in chat. Total refund S$39.60; one ask denied, so partially_upheld. Threat variant: 'you will regret it' names no harm, place or plan, so the expected Safety tier is verbal_abuse: protective actions, the money ruled as above, a person reviews afterwards.
stress_traps: Collector's quoted-vs-charged difference is S$12.60 (vs the original S$27 quote); the correct base is the updated S$30.00 quote
Rider claims the surge was hidden; the app shows the banner and the rider's acceptance
Driver says PIE was jammed; congestion is not a closure and the rider refused the ECP
Rider admits a spill in chat, but the cleaning photo is late, so the fee is reversed by rule
Rider has two fare disputes in 60 days: context only, must not decide the case
Three asks with different outcomes: label partially_upheld, refund S$39.60
Driver's 'you will regret it': verbal_abuse, not imminent; the money part is still ruled
